title: ioctl_key_import: success path falls through out_inbuf_clear label
description: After successful key_import, inbuf_clear is called inline (line 1552), state fields are set, ret=0, then execution falls through out_inbuf_clear: which calls inbuf_clear again. The comment at that label says 'on all error paths' but it runs on success too. The double call is harmless (inbuf is NULL after first clear; inbuf_clear checks this), but the label name and comment are misleading and a future maintainer adding logic before out_inbuf_clear: could introduce a bug. Suggested rewrite: add 'goto out;' before out_inbuf_clear: so the success path only calls inbuf_clear once, inline. This makes the label comment correct.
